description: .NET version upgrade plan from net8.0 to net10.0 for eShopOnWeb

tasks.description: Upgrade eShopOnWeb from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 across all 10 projects (ApplicationCore, BlazorAdmin, BlazorShared, Web, Infrastructure, PublicApi, UnitTests, PublicApiIntegrationTests, FunctionalTests, IntegrationTests).
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS, while the project is on .NET 8.0. Upgrading ensures access to the latest platform features, performance improvements, and extended long-term support through .NET 10's support lifecycle.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects from net8.0 to net10.0. Update the TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props and any individual .csproj overrides. Update the SDK version in global.json to 10.0.x. Update all NuGet package versions (AspNetCore, EntityFrameworkCore, System.* extensions, and third-party packages) to versions compatible with net10.0. Resolve any breaking API changes introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10, including changes in ASP.NET Core, Blazor WebAssembly, Entity Framework Core, and ASP.NET Core Identity. Ensure the solution builds successfully and all existing unit and integration tests pass.
